newsitem.title: USA: CSX begins merger talks with Conrail.
newsitem.headline: CSX begins merger talks with Conrail.

text.p: CSX Corp said Monday that it had begun negotiations with Conrail Inc related to their proposed merger.

"We look forward to these negotiations with great anticipation, fully expecting to resolve these issues and bring forth a proposal that will serve the best interests of all constituents and provide a pro-competitive solution in the East," CSX Chairman, President and Chief Executive John Snow said in a statement. Earlier in the day, Conrail said it would hold a board meeting Monday to consider options related to the proposed merger.
Conrail also said it will negotiate amendments to its planned merger with CSX so shareholders will receive $115 per share at the earliest possible date.

Conrail's statement confirmed signs given over the weekend that the four-month takeover battle for Conrail is likely nearing an end. Industry sources anticipate that CSX will buy Conrail and then divide the assets with rival bidder Norfolk Southern Corp.
